title: Linked EPS bearer identity information element

fields.name: Linked EPS bearer identity IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Linked EPS bearer identity

fields.name: Linked EPS bearer identity value
fields.description: The value identifying the linked EPS bearer

notes: The Linked EPS bearer identity is a type 1 information element

Purpose: to identify the default bearer that is associated with a dedicated EPS bearer or to identify the EPS bearer (default or dedicated) with which one or more packet filters specified in a traffic flow aggregate are associated
